findings.description: [AI-SAST via Code Scan Verification Validation | claude-opus-5] No default account or source-knowable default password remains. The privileged account's name comes from settings.CHEF_USERNAME, which config.py requires from the environment with no 'chef' fallback, and its password is produced per run by generate_random_secret() - 32 characters drawn with secrets.choice over letters/digits/punctuation and re-drawn until the shared password policy passes. The value is never printed or logged, and must_change_password=True makes the account unusable until the holder replaces it. The five sample accounts are likewise generated per run and are skipped entirely when ENVIRONMENT is ENV.PRODUCTION | verdict=pass confidence=high

[AI-SAST via Code Scan Verification Validation | claude-opus-5] The manual procedure is encoded as executable regression tests - each historic seeded credential is asserted to return 401 from /token, the seeding module is asserted to contain no quoted password literal and to call generate_random_secret(), generated secrets are asserted distinct and 32 characters across 50 draws, only CHEF_USERNAME is asserted created under ENV.PRODUCTION, and no demo role may be CHEF. The HISTORIC_DEFAULT_CREDENTIALS literals in this file are test fixtures proving those values are refused, not live credentials; the repository-wide scan in the same module looks for password-assignment context and exempts only this directory | verdict=pass confidence=high
